title: Read Recruitment Using Bowtie2
author: James E Thornton Jr
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.kevcte6

steps.title: Initialize Project Environment
steps.instruction: Log into the HPC and set up the working directory structure.

substeps.instruction: Log into the HPC using: ssh hpc ocelote
Navigate to your project directory: cd /rsgrps/bh_class/username
Create and enter a directory named 'read_recruit': mkdir read_recruit && cd read_recruit

steps.title: Simplify Contig FASTA Headers
steps.instruction: Rename the headers of the combined contigs file to a numerical count.

substeps.instruction: Navigate to the assembly output directory: cd /rsgrps/bh_class/username/assembly/megahit-out
Load the fastx module: module load fastx
Rename headers using fastx_renamer: fastx_renamer -n COUNT -I combined-contigs.fa -o final-contigs.fa
Alternative method if multi-line FASTA error occurs: awk '/^>/{print ">" ++i; next}{print}' contigs_out.fa

steps.title: Build Bowtie2 Index
steps.instruction: Create a Bowtie2 index for the simplified contigs.

substeps.instruction: Create directories for BAM files and the index: mkdir bam bt2_index
Enter the index directory: cd bt2_index
Load the bowtie2 module: module load bowtie2
Build the index: bowtie2-build -f /rsgrps/bh_class/username/assembly/megahit-out/final-contigs.fa contig_index

steps.title: Prepare FASTA Files for Mapping
steps.instruction: For paired-end data, ensure only the first pair (_1.fasta) remains in the fasta directory.

substeps.instruction: Navigate to the fasta directory: cd /rsgrps/bh_class/username/assembly/fasta
Move all second-pair files to the fastq directory: mv *_2.fasta ../../fastq

steps.title: Configure Alignment Script
steps.instruction: Create and edit a bash script (bt2_align.sh) to automate alignment and BAM conversion.

substeps.instruction: Navigate to the BAM directory: cd /rsgrps/bh_class/username/read_recruit/bam
Create directories for logs: mkdir std-err std-out
Create bt2_align.sh and update the following variables with your specific paths: FASTA_DIR, BT2_INDEX, OUT_DIR, and CONTIGS
Ensure the script includes the bowtie2 alignment parameters: --maxins 800 --fr --very-sensitive-local -p 4
Ensure the script includes samtools commands for conversion (-bT) and sorting

steps.title: Execute Alignment Job
steps.instruction: Submit the alignment script to the cluster queue.

substeps.instruction: Submit the job using qsub: qsub -e std-err/ -o std-out/ bt2_align.sh

steps.title: Verify Alignment Rates
steps.instruction: Check the standard error logs to determine the alignment rate for each file.

substeps.instruction: Navigate to the error directory: cd /rsgrps/bh_class/username/read_recruit/bam/std-err
View the error file using cat (e.g., cat [job_id].head1.cm.cluster.ER)

steps.title: Combine Partner Contigs
steps.instruction: Append your partner's final contigs to your own file.

substeps.instruction: Run: cat final.contigs.fa /rsgrps/bh_class/partnerusrname/assembly/megahit-out/final.contigs.fa > [output_file]
